rca_of_issues.root_cause: The northsms_routes.py was written assuming user object has 'id' key, but the auth system (auth.py) stores user_id in '_id' field. Additionally, balance was being read/written to users collection but the app uses a separate wallets collection.
reproduction_steps: 5. Backend returns 500 Internal Server Error with KeyError: 'id'
rca_of_issues.mitigation: Changed all occurrences of current_user['id'] to current_user['_id'] in northsms_routes.py. Changed db.users queries to db.wallets for balance operations.
